chunks: And whatever is in it from ʿAbd Allah ibn Hammad al-Anṣari, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAli ibn al-Husayn al-Saʿdābādi, from Ahmad ibn Abi ʿAbdillah al-Barqi, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Hammad al-Anṣari.

key_terms.الْبَرْقِيِّ: Part of the name Ahmad ibn Abi ʿAbdillah al-Barqi, a transmitter in the chain.
key_terms.الْمُتَوَكِّلِ: Part of the name Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil, included in the transmission route.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it; indicates direct transmission by the compiler through the stated chain.
key_terms.عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ الْأَنْصَار: A transmitter whose narrations are being linked through this sanad/isnad.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ: A transmitter appearing near the end of the sanad/isnad.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAbd Allah ibn Hammad al-Anṣari in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from ʿAbd Allah ibn Hammad al-Anṣari. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in hadith scholarship and clarifying the author’s route to this narrator.
